sun_illuminance — DRIVE env op

• Data kinds: scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sun_illuminance(elevation: 'float', cloud: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Dict[str, float]' (to call the implementation directly, import driveenv; driveenv.sun_illuminance(elevation: 'float', cloud: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Dict[str, float]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("sun_illuminance"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

晴天(雲量 `cloud ∈ [0, 1])の太陽の照度 [lx]: direct_normal(太陽に正対する面)・diffuse(水平面の散乱)・air_mass`。

直達 = 1361 W/m² × 0.7^{AM^0.678}(Meinel)× 105 lm/W × (1 − cloud)、AM = Kasten & Young 1989

1 / (sin h + 0.50572 (h + 6.07995°)^{−1.6364})。散乱 = 薄明の表(高度 ≤ 0)/ 400 + 16000 sin h(高度 > 0)に

雲で (1 + 0.5 cloud) を掛ける —— 仮定(モジュールの docstring)。
